newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia assigns more land for sugar cane.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia assigns more land for sugar cane.

text.p: Australia's sugar industry would further expand with a 4.7 percent increase in land assigned in Queensland for cane production in 1997, Queensland Sugar Corp, owner of the state's sugar crop, said.
The latest increase would follow a 5.4 percent increase in 1996, it said.
The 1997 increase of 22,645 hectares will bring the total area allocated to cane in Queensland to 506,423 hectares.
About one-quarter of the 1997 expansion will be allocated to the northern region of the canegrowing area.
The expanded land assignment follows a record sugar cane crush in Australia in 1996, when 39.543 million tonnes of cane were crushed, up from 37.390 million tonnes in 1996.
The 1996 sugar-make has yet to be announced.
Queensland produces almost all of Australia's sugar.
